Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.</p> <p><strong>Our Work Model</strong></p> <p>Hybrid: This is a hybrid role. You will work from our Boston office 2 to 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>You are the only People team member in the US and the first point of contact for colleagues in Boston and across the Americas. Your line manager and the wider People team are in Europe, so you will work independently for part of each day. About half the role is People Operations, a quarter is first-line employee relations and a quarter is Workplace Experience. It suits someone from a tech or software company who enjoys variety and uses common sense over rigid process. As you build relationships locally, the scope can grow into more employee relations and partnering.
